doubleTap.behavior: 추가 동작 없음; 단일 탭을 두 번 실행하지 않음

rightClick.behavior: 제품 전용 문맥 메뉴 없음; 브라우저 기본 동작 유지

hover.behavior: show grab cursor; handle remains visible

longPress.behavior: enter move mode; suppress following click

dragDrop.behavior: move row through valid positions from handle

swipe.behavior: row movement uses the handle, not a swipe

keyboard.behavior: Tab to handle; move up/down controls; Escape cancels

motionFlow.trigger: drag from handle or move up/down
motionFlow.immediateFeedback: dragging item and valid drop position
motionFlow.cancel: pointercancel/Escape/invalid drop restores original order and focus
